  "id": "2024-05-10",
  "wiki_content": "{{Update layout\n| prev_update = {{Update link|May|3|2024}}\n| month = May\n| day = 10\n| year = 2024\n| next_update =\n| source = https://forums.playdeadlock.com/threads/05-10-2024-update.689/\n| source_title = 05-10-2024 Update\n| notes =\nWe’ve heard a lot of feedback on matchmaking quality recently, especially with parties that include a wide range of skill spread and the impact they have on matches. We think it’s important to try to improve these as best we can so everyone can have fun playing. Options are a bit limited right now in general due to small queue sizes, but we have a few adjustments we are doing in today’s update that we hope will give us more potential to optimize and tweak the system in the immediate future. These changes will need continual tuning over the coming days, so the impact may not be fully visible today.\n\n* The match will no longer start at a fixed time immediately after 12 players are in the queue, sometimes it might start faster sometimes it might start slower, depending on the distribution of players in the queue. There will still be an upper bound for how long it waits, for practical reasons, but it won’t automatically start asap if it knows the match won’t be good. Conversely, if the match is already reasonable it won’t wait unnecessarily to start it.​\n​\n* Parties that have too high of a gap between the players in them will often make for a bad experience for both teams, but especially the opponents. When we detect that your party has this composition, we will present a warning letting you know that this will result in a more difficult match for your party and might also take longer to find a game, so you can decide if you value the group/social aspect more or not. In terms of specific matchmaking changes, in cases where the party has a large gap in skill, the party’s overall skill will now be biased closer to the best player’s values rather than the average. This will make it less likely that the system grabs lower skilled players for the opposing team just because your party was ok with wide variance.​\n\n\nThis update also has a couple of fixes that we are moving up from our usual end of week patch:\n\n* We fixed a bug when combining shields and resistance that caused you to take too much damage. Previously there was a bug where if you take a high amount of damage, the remaining damage after shield reduction would pass through as pure damage instead of being reduced by resist. An example of this is someone dealing 800 spirit damage to you and you having 80 Spirit Shield and 45% Spirit Resistance. With the bug, the 800 would be reduced to 720 from the shield, and then you would lose 720 health. With the fix, the shield now reduces the damage to 720 as usual, but the remaining amount then gets reduced by 45% to 396 health lost instead of 720.​\n​\n* We are also nerfing {{ItemIcon|Alchemical Fire}}. It now deals 40% less damage to non-heroes and the cooldown is increased from 25s to 37s.​\n}}"
}

reduced from 1.5 to 1.25\n* {{HeroIcon|Paradox}}: {{AbilityIcon|Time Wall}} no longer deals damage to [[Mid-Boss|Mid Boss]]\n* {{HeroIcon|Paradox}}: {{AbilityIcon|Kinetic Carbine}}: Max Damage Amp reduced from 150% to 125%\n* {{HeroIcon|Paradox}}: {{AbilityIcon|Kinetic Carbine}} T3 no longer provides +50% Min Damage Amp\n* {{HeroIcon|Paradox}}: {{AbilityIcon|Kinetic Carbine}} T3 reduced from +125% Max Damage to +75%\n\n* {{HeroIcon|Pocket}}: Gun damage per bullet reduced from 6 to 5.6\n* {{HeroIcon|Pocket}}: {{AbilityIcon|Affliction}} DPS reduced from 30 to 26\n\n* {{HeroIcon|Seven}}: {{AbilityIcon|Power Surge}} rebalanced around no longer reducing fire rate (similar shock value effectiveness as before)\n\n* {{HeroIcon|Warden}}: {{AbilityIcon|Alchemical Flask}} damage increased from 48 to 55\n\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: {{AbilityIcon|Crimson Slash}} cooldown reduced from 13s to 11s\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: {{AbilityIcon|Power Slash}} physics/world collision reduced from 15 to 4 (allowing it to be more easily used near objects)\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: Shadow Explosion radius increased from 14m to 16m\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: Shadow Explosion Fire Rate and Spirit buff duration increased from 15s to 20s\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: Shadow Explosion T3 Spirit bonus increased from +10% to +15%\n* {{HeroIcon|Yamato}}: Shadow Explosion T3 Fire Rate bonus increased from +5% to +10%\n\n\n\n[ Misc Gameplay Changes ]\n\n* Sprint is now always considered active as long as you are out of combat (haven’t taken or dealt damage for 5s, healthbar is now a little transparent when out of combat).\n* Fixed various inconsistencies and scenarios with how Sprint speed was calculated. Previously there were many conditions that could result in you losing the bonus.\n* [[Patron]] (Weakened) now has 40hp/s regen when it has not taken damage for 30s\n* Medic Troopers no longer use their heal on [[Trooper|troopers]] if there is a hero within 30m\n* [[Zipline]] Speed Boost cooldown reduced from 420s to 380s\n* Damage over time no longer prevents [[Zipline|zipline]] usage\n* Adjusted how the Anti Backdoor system works. It does a little less % damage reduction now, but it regens “backdoor damage” dealt to it over time. Backdoor damage is defined as any damage taken with no candle [[Trooper|troopers]] within 50m in the last 20 seconds.\n* Troopers run speed increased from 9.1 m/s to 10 m/s\n* Troopers DPS vs Patrons reduced from 110 DPS to 80 DPS\n* Troopers DPS vs [[Walker|Walkers]] from 110 DPS to 80 DPS\n* Troopers DPS vs Base [[Guardian|Guardians]] from 110 DPS to 80 DPS\n* [[Crate]] Powerups: Removed [[Zipline]] buff as a potential drop\n* [[Crate]] Powerups: Increased Health Regen drop from 1.25% Regen to 1.5%\n* [[Crate]] Powerups: Added Fire Rate drop, provides +20% Fire Rate for 25s\n* [[Sinner's Sacrifice|Vault]] base bounty increased from 200 to 225\n* Fixed some issues that allowed players to more easily camp players in the spawn area\n\n\n\nNote: 10% of users will default to vulkan rendersystem. If you experience any issues related to this, you can report these on the forums and switch to dx11 in the video settings. Deadlock will eventually drop support for dx11 and render on vulkan exclusively.\n}}"

When a user is detected as cheating, during the game session the opponents will be given a choice between banning the user immediately and ending the match or turning the cheater into a frog for the rest of the game and then banning them afterwards. The system is set to conservative detection levels as we work on a v2 anti-cheat system that is more extensive. We will turn on the banning of users in a couple of days after the update is out. When a match is ended this way, the results will not count for other players.\n\n\n\n* Added global quickcast support. You can now configure your abilities and/or items to be on quickcast mode globally. You can also customize each ability individually to be quickcast or not. This also supports grenade style abilities.\n* Hero specific keybinds now say the ability name instead of ability 1-4\n* Added [[Zipline]] hotkey that can be independently bound from space/jump\n* Fixed per-hero keys not inheriting user-defined default keys properly\n* Added keybind indicator for hero-specific binds showing which keys have been bound for that hero\n\n* Added Custom Match play mode\n* Private lobbies now have an option to turn on cheats\n* Private lobbies now let you select the specific servers to use\n* Private lobbies now have an option to make the match publicly visible or private to only the players\n* Private lobbies now support post-game and replays properly\n* Private lobbies now allow picking specific lanes (solo and dual lane colors are displayed)\n\n* Added a cheat report option in-game and post-game\n* Can now mute and report enemy players using ESC while in-game\n\n* Updated the game access invite UI to make it clear when users have been accepted (in most cases we look into where a user said their friend wasn't accepted, the user was actually accepted but they never claimed the game on the Steam notifications side)\n\n* Added voice indicators for   "wiki_content": "{{Update layout\n| prev_update = {{Update link|October|7|2024}}\n| month = October\n| day = 10\n| year = 2024\n| next_update =\n| source = https://forums.playdeadlock.com/threads/10-10-2024-update.36958/\n| source_title = 10-10-2024 Update\n| notes =\n[ Ranked Mode ]\n\n* Added Ranked mode\n\nWe are experimenting with a different approach to Ranked during early development, we expect to iterate on it in the future. The focus of this mode will be on concentrating players into specific time windows where they can opt into games where the primary focus is on game quality.\n\nYou must have 50 games played in order to enter this mode. If you have any behavior related restrictions (voice/text bans, report misuse, etc), you will be unable to queue into this mode.\n\nThe queue will be solo only at the moment and will be open from 1pm-4pm and 7pm-10pm in the respective time zones every day. Each region will have multiple time zones you can select from to find what best fits your schedule (you can only change your selection once per week). Players will be automatically assigned the server in that region that provides the best ping for the players in the match.\n\nWhen in this mode, you will only be matched with players that have the same medal as you. There are 11 medals in total with 6 levels in each. Everyone's medal and levels will be displayed in these ranked games.\n\nEvery Tuesday at 8PM GMT we will run an algorithm that calculates everyone's performance together at the same time based on the games you've played, how the opponents you played against ended up faring in subsequent games, etc. As such, medals will only be updated once per week, to allow for analysis of a wide set of match data together at once for a more accurate review of your skill (rather than a fixed numerical addition/subtraction on a per game basis).\n\nIn order to make sure there are enough data to cross reference with other players, you must play at least 7 games in order to be eligible to receive a rank for that week. If at any time you didn't have 7 games played in the previous week, your medal will be marked as undefined until you play enough and earn a new medal the following Tuesday.\n\nThe ranked queue will first open next Tuesday, October 15th at 8PM GMT. The first medals will be granted globally the following Tuesday, October 22nd 8PM GMT. You'll have a panel that shows you the history of your previous medals.\n\n\n\n[ General Changes ]\n\n* Added a 3rd casting mode, Quick Cast (shows range/radius/etc on key down, then on key up acts like Instant Cast). The three casting modes are now Instant Cast, Quick Cast, and Confirm Cast.\n\nView attachment quick_cast_modes.mp4\n\n\n* Added input buffering for ability usage (so if you cast an ability and then quickly cast another ability during its cast time, the next one will fire instead of the input being dropped)\n\nView attachment input_buffering.mp4\n\n\n* Now displaying a unique ID for builds in the description section of the build browser.  You can click on it to copy the Build ID to the clipboard to share specific builds with friends.\n* If you enter a Build ID in the search box of the build browser, it will show all of the builds for the current hero by the author of that build.\n\n* For private lobbies, added the ability to swap players on both teams with a button press. In addition players can be randomly shuffled across the two teams, and if lanes are being assigned, can be shuffled within the teams.\n* Added \"Allow Duplicate Heroes\" setting in Private The heroes are {{HeroIcon|Holliday}}, {{HeroIcon|Calico}}, Wrecker, Fathom, Viper and Magician (temp names). The goal of this mode is to invite players to help us in giving hero design feedback while heroes are in very early phases. Most heroes in this mode will have placeholder models, names, effects, etc (some exceptions are older in-dev heroes that had more developed art). They will also sometimes have placeholder/copy-paste abilities for certain slots if that ability slot is still TBD (such as Magician ultimate). There will be a specific hero labs section on the forum to post feedback on these. Heroes in this mode will often be removed, abilities changed, new heroes added, removed heroes re-added, etc. Patch notes for changes to heroes in this mode will be posted on the Hero Labs subforum. This mode will have limited testing hours for now while we gauge activity, in order to ensure faster queue times. You must have at least 50 games played to be able to queue here. If you don't get a new hero selected (since there are less new heroes than there are players), you will be considered higher priority for subsequent matches to get a new hero from your roster selection.\n\n* Added Commends. When you return to the [[Shop|shop]], you will automatically purchase the items you can afford in your set order. An indicator on the hud will light up when you can afford the next item on your list. In Settings you may change the purchase mode to use a hotkey while in range of the [[Shop|shop]] rather than auto-purchase.\n\n* The shaders, map and various other resources will now pre-compile on the dashboard to improve loading times when getting into a match. This also reduces in-game hitching in some cases.\n\n* Added a visual indicator when browsing builds that shows which item types are most present in the build (Weapon, Vitality, Spirit).\n\n* Added a Recent Purchases log to the [[Shop]] that displays all items bought by players during a match, ordered by most recent\n\n* Added support for the new Steam Game Recording Timeline API. This automatically adds timeline markers for kills, deaths, and team objectives.\n* Added checkbox in settings to force the game to take focus when the game is unpaused\n* You can now hover party members on the dashboard while in queue to view their roster\n* {{ItemIcon|Active Reload}} indicator UI slightly adjusted\n* Added \"Frenzied\" text when you own {{ItemIcon|Frenzy}} and go below 50% health\n* Added a Social tab to the Settings dialog. This contains Streamer Mode, added support for Steam content filtering settings and a new setting to adjust incoming chat visibility.\n\n* Hero Stats on the left side of the hud are now hidden by default, and can be viewed by holding ALT or TAB. When a stat is temporarily increased or decreased, it will show by default for the duration.\n* Added hover tooltip descriptions to stats on the left side of the hud\n\n* Bots will more aggressively attack the [[Shrine|Shrines]] and [[Patron]] when pushing into the enemy base\n* Fixed being able to briefly gain regen when crossing the [[Cosmic Veil|Veil]] of the enemy fountain\n* Fixed Commends for All Heroes not showing up correctly in player profiles\n* Updated {{HeroIcon|McGinnis}} {{AbilityIcon|Barrage}} explosions to show the edge of the aoe better\n* Fixed the 'x' button in the [[Shop|shop]] search not clearing the search box\n* Sinners Sacrifice now has a final damage state for clear read on final hit\n* Fixed some issues with {{AbilityIcon|Quantum Entanglement}} not moving units with it correctly when there is nearby geometry\n* Fixed various bugs with Duplicate Hero not working properly in private lobbies\n* Fixed {{HeroIcon|Grey Talon}} getting assist credit while flying {{AbilityIcon|Guided Owl}}\n* Fixed [[Sinner's Sacrifice]] changing facing direction sometimes\n* Fixed a rare bug where shields would never regenerate\n* Fixed some cases where [[Trooper|troopers]] could get stuck in the base\n* Fixed using melee to secure orbs being a little unresponsive\n* New effects for {{HeroIcon|Viscous}} heavy melee\n* Added an ambient looping sound for each bridge powerup\n* Fixed some animation issues with {{HeroIcon|Vindicta}}\n* Added new [[Zipline|zipline]] animation for {{HeroIcon|Vindicta}}\n* Looped music will resume playing if interrupted by a transient cue\n* Various bug fixes for looping sound effects and ones that are sometimes stuck playing every frame for a period of time\n* Improved animation readability for   "wiki_content": "{{Update layout\n| prev_update = {{Update link|November|13|2024}}\n| month = November\n| day = 21\n| year = 2024\n| next_update =\n| source = https://forums.playdeadlock.com/threads/11-21-2024-update.47476/\n| source_title = 11-21-2024 Update\n| notes =\n[ Matchmaking Rework ]\n\n* This update includes a new version of the matchmaker. The matchmaking pools are no longer split between normal and ranked, there is only one primary matchmaking mode and there are no limited hours.\n\n* Badges will update immediately whenever you gain or lose enough MMR to change badges. You no longer have to wait a week or play a certain game count. There will sometimes be monthly global maintenance updates where we readjust the global curve based on the population, cheaters banned, recalculation adjustments, etc (this will be done as needed and not necessarily every month).\n\n* Hero MMR is now used in the Matchmaker. Each player will have a \"core\" MMR and your MMR per hero will be offsets of your core MMR. When you queue, we will match you based on that hero's MMR. So if you are unfamiliar or play worse with a given hero, you will be put in an easier match than your usual. Judgement on your skill and familiarity with a hero will be based on the 20 most recent games with that hero. In your profile, we have UI that shows you what the matchmaker thinks your relative ranking for each hero is (give us feedback on this, we expect to iterate on this calculation).\n\n* Leaderboards are also included per region (North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Oceania). There is a top 1000 Core MMR leaderboard as well as a top 1000 Hero MMR leaderboard for each hero (for each region separately). To qualify for being considered in leaderboards in general, you must have 50 games played in the last 30 days. To qualify for a specific hero's leaderboard, you must have played at least 20 games on that hero in the past 30 days.\n\n* You can queue as any party size, however there are a few details. If the range of skill in your party is too wide, the amount of MMR you can gain will be reduced somewhat based on the degree. This is especially true if it’s a player we don't know anything about (like a very high mmr player queuing with a  \"new\" player, we will minimize updates to the known player until we are more confident we can trust the skill of that party overall).\n\n* The previous limit on high MMR party sizes is increased from 2 to 3. This applies to Ascendant 1 and above. This is the old limit we had on disallowing too many high MMR players to be in the same party together, for matchmaking quality reasons.\n\n* Given the updated no hour limits, if we think a match is a bad quality (like 5am games where there weren't a lot of players to pick from), we will weigh the match less heavily towards a rank update relative to what we would do with an average quality match.\n\n* If you prefer playing with only solos, there is a convar (mm_prefer_solo_only true) you can use.\n\n* When queuing as a party, you will have an option to override the default balance oriented lane assignment system and make the system prioritize putting your party members in the same lanes together.\n\n* Added Swap Lanes feature. During the rooftop and [[Zipline|zipline]] phase at the start of the game, you can now request to swap lanes with your teammates by clicking the button below their portrait on the scoreboard. If the other player accepts your request, you will immediately be swapped. You may decline an incoming request by right clicking it.\n\n* There is an option to notify you anytime your rank levels up. There is also an option to show the average badge of each team for the post game.\n\n\n\n\n[ General Changes ]\n\n* Added secondary key binds for actions\n* You are now able to browse and favorite builds in the dashboard\n* [[Sandbox]] mode now shows the souls value of the current items you have in your inventory\n* Abilitiy tooltips now list exactly which items the ability has been imbued with rather than \"Ability is imbued\"\n* Items in the [[Shop|shop]] that imbue abilities are tagged with a label with a similar styling to active items\n* Commend toasts now stay on your screen until they are dismissed\n* Commend toasts now have a button to return the commend to the player that commended you\n* Adjusted the behavior of the Incoming Damage UI so that it can still be used in [[Sandbox]] mode\n* There is now a Change Hero button in the Build Browser which brings up the hero picker to choose a different hero in both [[Sandbox]] and in the Dashboard\n\nQuickbuy:\n   - Decision dialogs for dealing with item limits, imbuing, and activation slots are now shown at queue time rather than purchase time whenever possible\n   - You can now queue items to sell.  If you right click on items that you own it will add them to the front of your quickbuy queue, and they will be queued to sell. The sale price of these items will be added to your current souls to calculate when you can afford to purchase the next item in your quickbuy queue..\n\n* Adjusted Powerup Runes' design to look more visually [[Breakable|breakable]] (due to melee change explained later in the gameplay section)\n\n* Low priority games now require wins to count\n\n* Gaining [[Rejuvenator]] buff now shows what stats have been improved on your hero (like powerups and other buffs)\n* Fixed {{HeroIcon|Abrams}} camera\n* Added icon variants for high or low ground for small/medium/large camps\n* Adding note below Cancel key in Settings explaining that \"Abilities will be cancelled with the Cancel Key when possible\"\n* Purchase Log in the [[Shop|shop]] now shows enemy and ally purchases with different colors\n* Fixed F1-F5 Keys not working (for moving camera to allies)\n\n* Updated active items to have uniform sliding/cast delay behavior\n    - Curse: Cast delay changed from 0.0s to 0.1s, to match other similar actives\n    - {{ItemIcon|Slowing Hex}}: No longer interrupts sliding, to match other similar actives\n    - {{ItemIcon|Decay}}: Cast delay changed from 0.25s to 0.1s, to match other ambient effects so that they are not visible at a distance\n* Visual revisions to Quantum entanglement effect\n* Reverted recent updates to {{HeroIcon|Shiv}} run animations\n* Increased volume and adjusted the mix of sounds for firing while disarmed and using abilities while silenced\n* {{HeroIcon|Lash}}'s {{AbilityIcon|Flog}} impact sound adjusted for better feedback for attacking player\n* spirit-based\n* Fixed {{HeroIcon|Bebop}}'s bomb damage growth not being reflected in the tooltip\n* Fixed {{HeroIcon|Grey Talon}}'s spirit power growth from his ult not being reflected in the [[Shop|shop]]\n* Fix to {{HeroIcon|Yamato}} {{AbilityIcon|Shadow Transformation}} visuals when duration is extended after killing an enemy\n* Fixed some item sounds playing on caster instead of target\n* Updated Krill VO - largely remastering pass, but some new content\n* Updated {{HeroIcon|Ivy}} VO - largely remastering pass, but also fixed some lines with Spanish pronunciation issues\n* Fixed a regression where {{HeroIcon|Kelvin}} referenced {{HeroIcon|Grey Talon}} incorrectly\n* Updated {{ItemIcon|Divine Barrier}} cast sound\n\n* Added Telemetry HUD options to the settings menu. The Telemetry HUD is an in-game HUD which can be used to monitor the frame rate and network conditions. The Telemetry HUD can be enabled under Settings > Game. More information on the HUD can be found here: https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/5E6F-5B36-5485-F6B9\n\n* Added new Learn to Play tutorial images in collaboration with Toastyghostey (https://www.instagram.com/toastyghostey/)\n\n* Steam Input Support:\n    - Added support for new Crouch Toggle button\n    - Added 3 new Official Control Schemes: { Standard | Gyro | FlickStick }. Thanks to @FlickStickVids for consultation.\n    - Added versioning system to Configs, so that outdated configs are unloaded\n\n\n\n\n[ Misc Gameplay ]\n\n* Added an Extra Competitive option to allow players to control what type of players are placed on their team. If you prefer to play with higher levels of coordination, communication, and competitiveness, then you can use this option to tell the matchmaker to build your team with like-minded allies. This option will sometimes be inactive in scenarios where the pool is very shallow (large portions of Eternus, off peak hours like 5am, extremely long queue, etc.), but otherwise in most normal scenarios the matchmaker will attempt to find you similar players.\n\n* The new Extra Competitive option, Incoming Chat, and Lane Preference (party only) settings are now collected within a 'Queue Options' button on the dashboard below the profile area\n\n* The recent change to increase party size allowed at the top MMR (from 2 to 3) reverted for Eternus and up, but maintained for Ascendant\n\n* The matchmaker will now try to prioritize each team having at least 2 frontliners when it has the option to do so\n\n* Ability Range stat now has diminishing stacking\n* Ability Duration stat now has diminishing stacking\n* Fire Rate now has a minimum final value of -50%\n\n* Heroes now have +0.5 Sprint\n* {{ItemIcon|Sprint Boots}} reduced from +2 Sprint to +1.5\n* {{ItemIcon|Enduring Speed}} reduced from +2 Sprint to +1.5\n\n* Carrying [[Urn]] now sets and limits your movespeed to a fixed 13 (this includes things like {{HeroIcon|Ivy}} {{AbilityIcon|Air Drop}}). It no longer provides sprint. The speed cannot be reduced or increased.\n* [[Urn]] spawn point now alternates left and right starting with left, rather than being random\n\n* Shooting a [[Trooper|trooper]] on a [[Zipline|zipline]] now causes other [[Trooper|troopers]] near it on the [[Zipline|zipline]] to dismount as well\n* Flying over buildings no longer causes you to get zapped, only standing on the building does\n\n* [[Patron]] HP reduced from 10k to 7.5k\n* Downed [[Patron]] HP reduced from 18k to 13.5k\n* [[Patron]] HP grows by 250/Min starting 20 min\n* Downed [[Patron]] HP grows by 450/Min starting 20 min (overall, these are -25% HP at 20 min, 0% at 30 min, and +25% at 40 min)\n\n* Added a tick based souls system that gives the bottom two net worth players on the team a small amount of souls per second. The amount of souls available to distribute to the bottom two players is based on the souls gathered by your team (2% and 1%). This occurs after the laning phase.\n\n* Added new limiting function for the [[Souls|soul]] orb duplication abuses during the laning phase. You shouldn't experience any real difference in normal gameplay:\n    Players can only participate in 4 [[Soul Orb]] share events per [[Trooper|trooper]] wave, before being declared lower priority. A low priority player is not counted for when deciding how many souls to generate.   "wiki_content": "{{Update layout\n| prev_update = {{Update link|October|24|2025}}\n| month = November\n| day = 21\n| year = 2025\n| next_update =\n| source = https://forums.playdeadlock.com/threads/11-21-2025-update.90383/\n| source_title = 11-21-2025 Update\n| notes =\n[ General ]\n\n* [[Trooper]] bounty mechanics have been reworked. The first half of the souls still fly out as deniable orb, however rather than the other half being instantly given to nearby players it will fall to the ground as an orb that you need to get near to pick up. It has a 18m capture radius where it'll travel to you once you get within. Only one player needs to claim it, share rules remain the same as before.\n* They last for 18s on the ground. Duration increases by 2s per minute up to 40s after 10 minutes.\n* Enemy orbs are visible as faint colorless [[Souls|soul]] orbs to your team, but cannot be claimed.\n* Amount of souls in the flying orb that can be secured/denied reduced from 50% to 40%\n* Very small tweaks to the secure/deny lag calculation to improve it\n* Increased [[Trooper|trooper]] range to be considered in range for souls to drop from 35m to 45m\n* Medic [[Trooper|troopers]] no longer have a passive healing pulse ability\n* Medic [[Trooper|troopers]] now drop a medic pack when you kill them. Has same pickup range/duration mechanics as the [[Souls|soul]] orbs on the ground. Heals everyone in a 30m radius for 10% of their missing health as well as 75 plus 2 per minute game time.\n\n\n* Starting souls count increased from 400 to 600\n* [[Trooper]] bounty values increased by 10%\n* [[Trooper]] bounty split ratios updated from 1/0.65/0.28/0.15/0.12/0.08 to 1/0.54/0.36/0.25/0.2/0.16\n\n\n* Reworked the position of your player camera and various details that affect visibility around your hero\n\n\n* [[Denizen|Neutrals]] bounty increased by 10%\n* [[Denizen|Neutrals]] HP increased by +15%\n* Small [[Denizen|neutrals]] damage +15%\n* Small [[Denizen|neutral]] camps respawn time 180s to 120s\n* Medium [[Denizen|neutrals]] spirit resist from 30% to 40%\n* Medium [[Denizen|neutrals]] damage increased by 25%\n* Hard [[Denizen|neutrals]] spirit resist increased from 35% to 50%\n* Hard [[Denizen|neutrals]] damage increased by 30%\n* [[Sinner's Sacrifice]]: Return damage increased from 60 to 80\n* Minimum unsecured gold to drop increased from 100 to 150\n* Sprint/Out of Combat regen timer against [[Denizen|neutrals]] increased from 0.5s to 2.5s (takes longer to start sprinting/regening)\n\n\n* Reduced all AP damage upgrades by 10%\n* Base gun damage and gun damage growth increased by 10% (excluding {{HeroIcon|Paige}})\n* Headshot multiplier reduced from 1.8x to 1.65x\n* Weapon Investment Bonuses: Now grants an additional +20% Weapon Damage at 4800 souls spent\n* Vitality Investment Bonuses: Now grants an additional +12% Bonus Health at 4800 souls spent\n* Spirit Investment Bonuses: Now grants an additional +20 Spirit Power at 4800 souls spent\n* Added a UI highlight to 4800 reward row of the investment bonuses\n\n\n* Initial wall jump now costs 0.25 stamina\n* Stamina regen rate reduced by 5% (5s to 5.25s)\n\n\n* After 35 minutes all [[Trooper|troopers]] gain +50% HP.\n* [[Guardian|Guardians]] HP increased from 3500 to 4250 HP\n* [[Walker]] HP increased by 40%\n* [[Walker]] on the Side Lanes now have same HP as Midlane (rather than ~37% less)\n* [[Walker]] engagement ranges reduced (ranges for attacks, being attacked, stomps, etc)\n* [[Walker]] stomp cooldown reduced from 10s to 6s\n* [[Walker]] stomp damage increased from 350 + 10% Max HP to 350 + 15% Max HP\n* [[Walker]] fireballs radius from 5m to 6m\n* [[Walker]] fireballs debuff now lingers for 4s\n* [[Walker]] fireballs now reduce bullet and spirit resistance by 10%\n* [[Walker]] area in mid lane adjusted\n* Bullet Damage is no longer reduced by 35% of a Hero's Base Bullet damage against T1's\n* [[Guardian|Guardians]] now start with 75% Damage Resist that decay's to -50% over the first 10 minutes of a match\n* [[Walker|Walkers]] now start with 75% Damage Resist that decay's to -50% over the first 20 minutes of a match\n* Note: The [[Walker]] resistance change used to be in the client a couple months ago, but it got bugged.\n\n* Base slot count increased from 8 to 9 and Flex slot count reduced from 4 to 3. One is given for each [[Walker]] killed. Previously the 4 were given for: \"3 [[Guardian|Guardians]]\", \"1 [[Walker]]\", \"3 [[Walker|Walkers]]\", and \"Set of Base [[Guardian|Guardians]]\"\n\n\n* [[Rejuvenator|Rejuv]] buff no longer grants +10% Max HP, +15% Fire Rate and +15% Spirit Damage Amp\n* [[Mid-Boss|Mid Boss]] base health increased from 13000 to 14000\n* [[Mid-Boss|Mid Boss]] health growth per minute increased from 200 to 230\n* Team that kills [[Mid-Boss|Mid Boss]] gets +2 permanent buffs for each player\n\n\n* Dropping / Throwing the [[Urn]] now causes {{AbilityIcon|Parry}} to go on CD\n* {{AbilityIcon|Soul Urn}} no longer grants +1 AP to the person dropping it off\n* {{AbilityIcon|Soul Urn}} now provides 4 Permanent Buffs to the person dropping it off\n* Added two levels at 47k and 49k to let you get all ability upgrades\n\n\n* {{AbilityIcon|Jump}} Pad stun window increased from 0.6s to 0.9s\n* When meleeing an enemy that is mantling and the mantle slow is applied, mantle sliding right after wards is no longer allowed\n\n\n* Subsequent CC reduction increased from 7%/21% to 8/24%\n\n\n* Survival Buff hp regen changed from 0.5->1.5% Max HP to 4->40 Fixed Regen\n* Gun Buff ammo increased from 20->60% to 35->70%\n* Gun Buff now reloads your ammo on pickup\n* Casting Buff spirit power increased from 15>40 to 15->65\n* Casting Buff cooldown reduction rescaled from 12->25% to 12->20%\n* Movement Buff stamina from 1->4 to 2->4\n\n\n* Added new [[Trooper|trooper]] anti-stuck behavior to fix some places where you can move a [[Trooper|trooper]] to get them stuck.\n* Fixed a bug where [[Trooper|troopers]] could clip into the world while running up stairs and over obstacles\n\n\n\n[ Items ]\n\nCooldown Reduction Changes:\n* {{ItemIcon|Enchanter's Emblem}}: Cooldown Reduction reduced
